name: ui-ux-standard
description: Reusable UI/UX workflow for design systems, component and template discovery, mockups, media prompts, visual assets, accessibility, responsive QA, and frontend visual validation.

interface.shortDescription: Standardize design systems, component selection, mockups, accessibility, and visual QA.
interface.longDescription: UI/UX Standard gives Codex a repeatable workflow for creating and reviewing product UI: inspect existing design systems, search project-native and approved external component sources before inventing UI, define design tokens, create approved mockups, manage media prompt PRDs, document components, validate accessibility and responsiveness, and verify rendered UI before frontend completion.
defaultPrompt: Use UI/UX Standard to create the design plan and component-source inventory for this feature.
Use UI/UX Standard to initialize only the required docs/design artifacts for this project.
Use UI/UX Standard to review this UI against the approved mockup, design system, component choices, and anti-generic visual quality gate.
